rules.text: Every desk must be empty before you leave.
rules.truth: The stair door stays locked until all six personal items are returned to their owners' lockers.
There are 24 chairs: 12 at desks, 8 at the meeting table, 4 along the walls.
'Leave' means step back out through the entrance you came in by. Then return.
rules.clue: The monitors spell the count when the extra chair arrives.
